files.policies.yml:
version: 1
base_currency: OMR
accounts: [salary, savings, broker, cash]
categories:
  income: [salary, bonus, side]
  expense: [housing, food, transport, family, discretionary, fees]
  transfer: [transfer]
  invest: [buy, sell, dividend]
snapshot_max_age_days: 45
policies:
  - id: CAP-SEP
    type: cap
    title: food per month
    measure: {sum: expense.food, period: month}
    limit: {value: 100}
  - id: CAP-Q
    type: cap
    title: food per quarter
    measure: {sum: expense.food, period: quarter}
    limit: {value: 300}
  - id: SHAPE
    type: cap
    title: a measure that is not declared
    measure: {average: expense.food, period: month}
    limit: {value: 100}
  - id: RED
    type: red_line
    title: no margin
    match: {tags_any: [margin]}
  - id: ROUT
    type: routine
    title: monthly transfer to savings
    match: {tags: transfer, account: savings}
    period: month
  - id: CAP-FX
    type: cap
    title: discretionary per month
    measure: {sum: expense.discretionary, period: month}
    limit: {value: 100}
